title: The Remaining Land Divided

questions.question: Within whose inheritance did Simeon receive their portion?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:1 (ESV): "...Its inheritance was in the midst of the inheritance of the people of Judah."

questions.question: Why was Simeon's inheritance within Judah?
options: Because the portion of the people of Judah was too large for them
questions.correctAnswer: Because the portion of the people of Judah was too large for them
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:9 (ESV): "...for the portion of the people of Judah was too large for them."

questions.question: Which tribe received the third lot?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:10 (ESV): "The third lot came up for the people of Zebulun..."

questions.question: The inheritance of Dan was primarily in what type of cities?
options: Valleys and plains leading to the sea
questions.correctAnswer: Valleys and plains leading to the sea
questions.explanation: Contextually, Dan's cities like Ekron and Joppa are coastal/lowland.

questions.question: What difficulty did the people of Dan have?
options: They lost their territory and had to fight for Leshem
questions.correctAnswer: They lost their territory and had to fight for Leshem
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:47 (ESV): "When the territory of the people of Dan was lost to them, they went up and fought against Leshem..."

questions.question: What special inheritance was given to Joshua?
options: Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim
questions.correctAnswer: Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:50 (ESV): "...they gave him the city that he asked, Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim."

questions.question: The fourth lot came out for whom?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:17 (ESV): "The fourth lot came out for Issachar..."

questions.question: Asher's territory reached to which major city?
Naphtali's fortified cities included which famous one?
What did the Danites rename Leshem?
options: Dan, after the name of Dan their ancestor
questions.correctAnswer: Dan, after the name of Dan their ancestor
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:47 (ESV): "...and they called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their ancestor."

questions.question: Where did they finish dividing the land?
options: At Shiloh, at the entrance of the tent of meeting
questions.correctAnswer: At Shiloh, at the entrance of the tent of meeting
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:51 (ESV): "...at Shiloh before the Lord, at the entrance of the tent of meeting."

questions.question: Bethlehem is mentioned in whose inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:15 (ESV): "...Bethlehem... twelve cities with their villages." (Note: There is a Bethlehem in Zebulun, distinct from Bethlehem-Judah).

questions.question: Mount Tabor is a boundary for which tribes?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:22, 34 mentions Tabor in relation to Issachar and Naphtali/Zebulun borders.

questions.question: Which tribe's coast reached to Carmel?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:26 (ESV): "...reaching to Carmel on the west..."

questions.question: Did Joshua receive his inheritance before or after the people?
options: After they had finished distributing the land
questions.correctAnswer: After they had finished distributing the land
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:49 (ESV): "When they had finished distributing the several territories... the people of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua..."

key_verse_text: These are the inheritances that Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers houses of the tribes of the people of Israel distributed by lot at Shiloh before the LORD, at the entrance of the tent of meeting. So they finished dividing the land. (ESV)
